entries.question_fil: Paano gumamit ng bukas na tanong sa pakikipag-usap ng BHW?
entries.question_en: How does a BHW use open questions in an interview?
entries.answer_fil: Magsimula sa tanong na nagpapakuwento, gaya ng “Ano ang naging hadlang?” Makinig bago maglinaw ng isang detalye. Iwasang isama sa tanong ang paratang o inaasahang sagot.
entries.answer_en: Start with a question that invites an account, such as asking what got in the way. Listen before clarifying one detail. Avoid accusations or an expected answer inside the question.

entries.question_fil: Paano susuriin ng BHW ang nakalap na impormasyon?
entries.question_en: How should a BHW assess gathered information?
entries.answer_fil: Ihiwalay ang sinabi ng tao, sariling obserbasyon at hindi pa nakukumpirma. Itala ang pinagmulan at linawin ang kulang; huwag ipasa ang hula bilang katotohanan.
entries.answer_en: Separate the person’s account, direct observations and unconfirmed details. Record the source and clarify gaps; never present a guess as fact.

entries.question_fil: Paano maglahad ng maikling ulat matapos ang household interview?
entries.question_en: How do I present a short report after a household interview?
entries.answer_fil: Iulat ang kaugnay na concern, petsa, pinagmulan, ginawa at susunod na hakbang gamit ang aprubadong form. Ibigay sa tamang health team member sa awtorisadong paraan at kumpirmahin ang pagtanggap.
entries.answer_en: Report the relevant concern, date, source, action and next step using the approved form. Send it to the appropriate health team member through an authorized channel and confirm receipt.

entries.question_fil: Paano gagamit ng teach-back sa paliwanag ng susunod na hakbang?
entries.question_en: How do I use teach-back to explain the next step?
entries.answer_fil: Anyayahan ang tao na sabihin ang plano sa sariling salita. Kapag may hindi nagtugma, baguhin ang paliwanag at muling itanong. Linaw ng paliwanag ang sinusuri, hindi talino ng kausap.
entries.answer_en: Invite the person to describe the plan in their own words. If meaning differs, revise the explanation and check again. This checks the explanation’s clarity, not the person’s intelligence.
